# FitFusion

> FitFusion is a personalized AI fitness coaching platform offering adaptive workout plans, progress tracking, nutrition logging, biometric syncing, and a supportive community.

## Pages

- [Home](/): AI-powered fitness dashboard with today's workout, streaks, and personalized insights.
- [Workouts](/workouts): Browse and start guided workouts filtered by goal, level, and equipment.
- [Workout Plans](/workout-plans): Multi-week AI-generated training programs tailored to your goals.
- [Progress](/progress): Track streaks, personal records, body metrics, and long-term trends.
- [Nutrition](/nutrition): Log meals and monitor macros aligned with your training.
- [Community](/community): Join challenges, share transformations, and follow other members.
- [Chat](/chat): FitX Fusion AI Chat for real-time coaching and form guidance.
- [Tools](/tools): AI fitness utilities, calculators, and workout generators.
- [AI Workout Generator](/tools/ai-workout-generator): Free public AI workout planner — personalized routines by goal, equipment, and level.
- [Wearables](/wearables): Sync data from smartwatches and fitness trackers.
- [Subscription](/subscription): Premium plans with advanced AI features.
- [Help](/help): Support and getting-started guides.
